title: Concentrated-load coefficient argument ratios

symbols.definition: Height of the top of the conduit to ground surface in m
Outside width of conduit in m, and
Effective length of the conduit to which the load is transmitted in m.

applicability: Arguments for the load coefficient C_s. Effective length is generally taken as 1 m or the actual length of conduit if less than 1 m.
notes: Transcriber note: this numbered expression contains two ratios, not an equality. The adjacent prose refers to Table 3.20 for C_s; Table 3.20 is visibly the cohesion table, whereas Table 3.21 carries load coefficients. The printed reference is not silently repaired.
